# Gustavo Lara

> Gustavo Lara is a Brazilian Software Architect and Tech Lead (Cuiabá, Mato Grosso) with 8+ years of experience and 20+ delivered projects. He specializes in legacy modernization, distributed architectures, microservices in Go and Java, applied AI (local and cloud LLM orchestration), native code interoperability, and web, mobile and IoT ecosystems.

Languages: Portuguese (native), English, Spanish. Education: Technology degree in Internet Systems, Instituto Federal de Mato Grosso (IFMT), Cuiabá campus.
